items.name: powdered milk
items.amount: 1/4 taza de leche en polvo (opcional, queda con un sabor más lácteo y muy melcochudo- si no se la pones, remplaza por harina)
items.note: optional, gives a more dairy and very sweet flavor - if not used, replace with flour

steps.text: Mix the eggs with the sugar.
Then add the melted butter and mix.
Add the Milo and powdered milk.
Add the flour and salt and mix until incorporated.
Prepare your molds with the link below and add the mixture. Bake in a preheated oven at 180 C for 35 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.
To prevent sticking, mix 1 teaspoon of cocoa powder with 1 teaspoon of butter or neutral oil and spread this mixture on your mini cocottes from @victoriacocinacastiron.
Add a little raw mixture when it comes out of the oven. If you prefer not to add raw mixture, you can make a mixture of Milo and cream as a sauce.
You will see your addiction to this recipe ❤️‍🩹 and hopefully you can make it for your mom (there is nothing they like more than what we make with our hands).
